pages.text: $(#8B0000)🔥 Crimson Overload · Paradoxical Symphony 💫$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF4500)「Sacrificing speed in exchange for eyes that pierce darkness and fists that shatter stone」$()$(br)The $(#8B0000)energy pulses of Redstone$(), the $(#00BFFF)cold glow of Glowstone$(), and the $(#FF4500)volatile blaze of Blaze Powder$() are forcibly fused with $(#9370DB)Lavender$()—a dangerous alchemical masterpiece capable of $(l)forcing mortal flesh to endure energy overload$().

$(#8B0000)▌ Energy Paradox $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF0000)⚡ Crimson Overload$()$(br)Fists erupt with $(#FF4500)molten lava crack$() effects when striking.$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)🦉 Night Owl’s Crimson Vision$()$(br)A $(#8B0000)blood moon filter$() covers the view, piercing through darkness.$(br2)$(l)$(#808080)⚠ Energy Backlash $()$(br)$(l)$(#696969)⛓ Redstone Shackles$()$(br)Feet become entangled with $(#8B0000)energy tassels$(), reducing movement speed.

$(br2)$(#9370DB)▌ Dangerous Brewing $()$(br)- Grind $(#8B0000)Redstone Dust$() and $(#FF4500)Blaze Powder$() with $(#00BFFF)Glowstone$() until it reaches $(#FF0000)luminescent form$().$(br)- When adding $(#9370DB)Lavender$(), one must chant the $(#8B0000)Neutralization Spell three times$().$(br)- Stir $(#4169E1)counterclockwise in a single direction$() throughout the process.$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() Stop heating immediately when the liquid exhibits $(#FF4500)lava pulsations$() and $(#9370DB)purple mist$().

$(br2)$(#8B0000)『 Forbidden Alchemy Notes 』$()$(br)A scorched parchment fragment:$(br)'This drink contains both $(#8B0000)destruction$() and $(#9370DB)order$(),$(br)granting $(#FF4500)tremendous excavation strength$() and $(#4169E1)night-piercing crimson vision$(),$(br)yet your $(#696969)legs$() will feel as if trapped in $(#8B0000)an energy swamp$()—$(br)a $(#FF0000)law of energy conservation$(), a $(#00BFFF)gentle warning$() for the $(#9370DB)greedy$().'
